name: better-codex
title_zh: Codex 干活前先念三遍的六条行为红线
tagline_zh: 专治 AI 改代码时的自作主张：不乱扩范围、不假装完成、不硬凑补丁。基于真实用户吐槽提炼。
tagline_en: Stops Codex from scope-creeping, faking completion, and patching over cracks. Distilled from real user.
desc_en: Behavioral guardrails for Codex coding work based on common user complaints. Use when Codex is asked to implement, modify, debug, review, test, or operate on a codebase and should avoid unsafe scope expansion, stale edits, fake completion, brittle edits, shallow debugging, superficial patch-on fixes, one-off special-case code, short-term design choices that hurt maintainability, blindly following
why_zh: 不是提示词模板，是把用户抱怨转成可执行的否决清单。每条红线对应一类具体劣质行为。
why_en: Not a prompt template—a veto list built from actual complaints. Each rule targets one concrete bad habit, so Codex self-checks.
limit_zh: 只约束 Codex 官方 CLI 的编码行为，不覆盖其他 AI 工具；不检查代码正确性，只拦行为模式。
limit_en: Only guards Codex CLI coding behavior, not other tools. Doesn't verify correctness—only blocks behavioral patterns. Requires Codex installed and.
title_en: Six behavioral guardrails Codex reads before touching code
